sloka: ऋषयो ऽप्यद्य पापात्मन्मया त्वां निहतं रणे ।पश्यन्तु विप्रा विद्वांसस्त्रिदशा इव रावणम् ।। ७.६९.५ ॥
transliteration: ṛṣayo 'pyadya pāpātmanmayā tvāṁ nihataṁ raṇe ।paśyantu viprā vidvāṁsastridaśā iva rāvaṇam ।। 7.69.5 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna wished that the sages, Brahmins, and learned ones, like the gods witnessing Ravana's fall, would today see him slay the evil-souled Lavaṇa in battle.
